instruction: Navigate to the React Developer Tools extension page in the Chrome Web Store.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent read plugin list document, switched to Chrome, navigated to Chrome Web Store, searched for 'Zoom Chrome Extension', found and opened its detail page, clicked 'Add to Chrome', but installation was blocked with 'Installation is not enabled' error. Agent stayed on the Zoom extension page for remaining turns, never attempted other plugins.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can read documents in LibreOffice Writer, switch between applications, navigate to Chrome Web Store, search for extensions by name, click on search results to open extension detail pages, interact with 'Add to Chrome' button and permission dialogs
metadata.failure_analysis: Extension installation is disabled in the VM environment. The model got stuck after the first 'Installation is not enabled' error on Zoom Chrome Extension and did not attempt any of the other 4 plugins. The model lacked error recovery strategy.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed original multi-plugin installation task into a single navigation task. Model demonstrated it can search and find extension pages. This variation tests finding React Developer Tools, a developer-focused extension with a different search term.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from the initial LibreOffice Writer view to Chrome Web Store and finding the React Developer Tools extension detail page. Evaluator checks the active tab URL matches the React Developer Tools extension detail page pattern using regex.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active browser tab URL, which is the right state to verify navigation.
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly receives the rules dict and accesses rules['expected'] for regex patterns, matching the framework's type='rule' behavior.
Regex pattern 'chromewebstore\.google\.com/detail/react-developer-tools' correctly matches the Chrome Web Store detail page URL for React Developer Tools.
Instruction only requires navigating to the extension page; checking the active URL provides complete verification coverage.
No postconfig needed since URL state persists in the browser tab.
